verdict.rationale: The evidence only loosely suggests bulk work. The vendor offers to 'automate repetitive tasks' and 'hand off repetitive work', and Cowork handles 'bigger, multi-step tasks'. Connectors can query across many items (e.g. 'Show me all PDFs'), and one user praised fetching data across 365 documents, but nothing documents applying an action to many items at once, and one hands-on report says Copilot in Word could not even do search and replace. Missing for 10: an explicit documented bulk-action capability (e.g. batch edit, move, delete or send across many files or emails), details on scale or limits, and independent confirmation that bulk operations work.
